defaults.unsubscribeText: You are receiving this because you requested a Jimmy Coco Pro spray-tan profit plan and a member of staff confirmed this professional follow-up was appropriate.

messages.title: What your spray-tan numbers are really showing
messages.preview: A calm read of the volume and profit assumptions in your PDF plan.
messages.headline: The useful part is knowing which assumptions deserve your attention.

blocks.html: Your PDF model for {{{BUSINESS_NAME}}} estimated {{{MONTHLY_PROFIT}}} a month and approximately {{{LITRES_PER_MONTH}} litres of solution a month from the figures you entered.
That is not an earnings promise. It is a working model that makes the assumptions visible: treatment volume, price, chair time, consumables, room costs and retail contribution.
The best next step is to change one assumption at a time and see which number materially changes the result.
Reply NUMBERS if you would like Matthew to look at the model with you.

messages.title: The three levers behind your spray-tan margin
messages.preview: Volume, chair time and service price usually move the model more than solution cost alone.
messages.headline: A cheaper litre is rarely the whole margin story.

blocks.html: At {{{TANS_PER_WEEK}}} tans a week, the model for {{{BUSINESS_NAME}}} is shaped by three practical levers.

items: Volume: more treatments spread the same room costs across more appointments.
Chair time: consultation, application and reset time affect the full delivery cost.
Service value: the price must support the experience and result your client is booking.

blocks.html: Solution cost matters, but judging a professional formula only by the litre price can hide the larger commercial picture.
Reply MARGIN for a human review of the assumptions.

messages.title: The numbers matter—but the client result comes first
messages.preview: A commercial model is most useful once you know the colour and service fit your salon.
messages.headline: Before an order decision, test the service you would actually deliver.

blocks.html: The calculator can show whether the service structure looks viable for {{{BUSINESS_NAME}}}. It cannot tell you how the colour applies through your equipment, how it develops on a real client or how naturally it fits your treatment menu.
That is why the complimentary 100ml professional trial exists: to let an eligible UK salon assess the result before committing to the full ordering route.
Reply TRIAL if you would rather arrange it with Matthew directly.

messages.title: Your next step from the profit plan
messages.preview: Rework the numbers, test the professional solution or discuss the order route.
messages.headline: The calculation has done its job if it makes the next decision clearer.

blocks.html: I will leave the timing with you after this note. For {{{BUSINESS_NAME}}}, there are three straightforward routes from here.

items: Reopen the calculator and test a more conservative or ambitious scenario.
Request the complimentary professional trial and assess the result on a real client.
Review the professional ordering route if the result and service model are already clear.

blocks.html:
Trial route: request a complimentary 100ml trial.
Order route: view the professional solution.
Reply NUMBERS, TRIAL or ORDER and Matthew will pick it up personally.
